title: Powerball jackpot odds, before vs. after the 2015 rule change

source.name: Powerball matrix change, October 2015
source.publisher: Multi-State Lottery Association, as widely reported by lottery-odds trackers

notes: In October 2015, Powerball deliberately widened its number pool, worsening jackpot odds from about 1 in 175 million to 1 in 292 million, specifically to grow jackpot size via more rollovers.
